top_signals.title: Australian Stocks Rise to Record on Iran Hopes, Economic Bets
top_signals.summary: Australia’s stock benchmark climbed to an intraday record on easing concerns over the US-Iran conflict and supportive signals in the domestic economy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China’s Quant Curbs Sap Volatility and Turnover: Equity Insight
top_signals.summary: China’s latest initiative to rein in quantitative trading is proving something of a double-edged sword for the stock market as it has reduced volatility, but also sapped turnover.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: 53 cultural properties damaged by Kumamoto quake
top_signals.summary: The affected assets include three national treasures and 11 national important cultural properties.
